chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Muʿāwiyah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jabalah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from Zurārah, who said:
I heard Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام saying: “Indeed, for al-Qāʾim عليه السلام there shall be a ghaybah (Occultation) before he rises.”
I said: “And why?” He عليه السلام said: “Because he fears,” and he gestured with his hand toward his belly, meaning killing.

key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: al-Qāʾim, the Imam who will rise
key_terms.غَيْبَةً: occultation or absence from public view
key_terms.يَقُومَ: to rise or begin his mission openly

ai.seo_question: Why will al-Qāʾim عليه السلام enter ghaybah before his rise?
ai.summary: This hadith states that al-Qāʾim عليه السلام will have a ghaybah (Occultation) before his rise. It explains that the reason for this occultation is fear of being killed, indicating a divinely significant period preceding his public appearance.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Muawiya, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Zurara who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘For Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> there would be an absence (Occultation) before his<sup>asws</sup> rising’.
I said, ‘And why (would that be so)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> he<sup>asws</sup> would fear’, and he<sup>asws</sup> gestured by his<sup>asws</sup> hand towards his<sup>asws</sup> belly, meaning the murder’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Mu‘awiya from ‘Abdallah ibn Jabala from ‘Abdallah ibn Bukayr from Zurara who has said the following. “I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say as herein below. “The person who will rise to Divine power on earth will disappear from the public sight before he will do so.”
I then asked, “Why, will happen so?”
He said, “He will be afraid.” He then pointed to his midsection meaning thereby being murderd.”
